text.zh_CN: 欢迎来到远望交易学院。你的模拟账户里有 10 万美元，市场每天 09:30 开盘、16:00 收盘。这里亏掉的钱不会真的消失，但你的坏习惯会。
text.en: Welcome to Farview Trading Academy. Your simulated account holds $100,000. The market opens at 09:30 and closes at 16:00. Losses here are not real, but bad habits are.

text.zh_CN: 先别急着下单。我带你走到工位：左边是行情，中间是交易台，右边是你的持仓。今天只有一个任务——弄明白你买入的到底是什么。
text.en: Don't rush to trade. I'll walk you to your desk: quotes on the left, the ticket in the middle, your positions on the right. Today's only task is to understand what you are buying.

text.zh_CN: 第一家公司，你打算先看什么？
text.en: For your first company, what do you look at first?

text.zh_CN: 先读财报和估值，再决定价格是否合理。
text.en: Read the filings and valuation before judging the price.

text.zh_CN: 先看价格走势和成交量，市场会告诉我答案。
text.en: Start with price action and volume; the market will tell me.

text.zh_CN: 稳妥的起点。记住：财报是过去，价格是预期。你要做的是找出两者之间的差距，而不是相信任何一个数字。
text.en: A solid start. Remember: filings describe the past, prices describe expectations. Your job is to find the gap, not to trust either number.

text.zh_CN: 市场派的答案。趋势能持续，也能瞬间反转。至少给自己写一条退出规则，否则你交易的不是趋势，是情绪。
text.en: The market's answer. Trends persist and then break. Write an exit rule for yourself, or you will be trading emotion instead of trend.

text.zh_CN: 去行情页选一家公司，读完它的资料卡，然后下你的第一笔单。别用满仓证明勇气——仓位管理才是职业和业余的分界线。
text.en: Pick a company on the Market screen, read its profile, then place your first order. Don't prove courage with full size — position sizing is the line between professional and amateur.
